name: Text to Speech
description: Natural voiceovers in 21 languages, and clone a voice from a short sample.
details: Chatterbox Multilingual by Resemble AI (MIT), exported to ONNX by onnx-community. Drift speaks text in 21 languages with a q4-quantized language model, and can match a reference voice from a short recording. Package id: tts.chatterbox-multilingual.
author: CutWire
